result.analyst_notes: The page is almost entirely navigation and contact material: addresses, phone numbers, store-locator and shopping prompts, and a recruiting line. It states no values, commitments or priorities, so no stakeholder is addressed. The only value-related item, the menu label 'Apple Values', is chrome rather than content. Tone is transactional and impersonal, with no first-person voice and no hedged or absolute commitments.
